theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_id_weight_hull
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ), IsVarifoldOf V M θ → ∃ T : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet T ∧ {x | x ∈ M ∧ ∃ S : Grassmannian N n, Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x S.plane} ⊆ T ∧ V.weight = (((μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict M).withDensity fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (θ x)).restrict T ∧ ∀ B : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet B → V.weight B = ∫⁻ x in {x | x ∈ M ∧ ∃ S : Grassmannian N n, Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x S.plane} ∩ B, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n]
